questions.question: A process whose name contains a dot is silently mixed up with a shorter-named process, because the message router reads the first dot-separated segment of an address as the process. Such a name must instead be reported as a validation error, both by the whole-topology validation that runs when the system boots or hot-switches a recipe, and by the cheaper structure-only gate that runs when a recipe is saved or loaded. In which two methods of the topology blueprint class must the new check be wired in?
questions.note: class=described. Derived from 44bb41f94 (C25.1). git show 44bb41f94: the existing check_structure and check changed (a call to the new helper _dotted_process_names added to both; the helper itself is new so it is not in the reference). Both needed.

Four existing places must be extended for a new kind: the module-level tuple that lists the allowed kinds, the factory function that builds a backend object for a kind, the typing alias (Literal) used by the plugin config to restrict the kind, and the plugin method that assembles the keyword arguments passed to the factory. questions.question: A plugin input slot currently carries one boolean that means both 'may be left unconnected' and, implicitly, 'does not take part in correlating inputs by sequence id into one joined item'. The owner wants a separate, independent declaration of participation in the join (default: same as before). Which class defines the slot contract, which blueprint method counts which wires count as join sources, and which built-in command handler that serves the plugin catalog to a remote GUI must additionally expose the new flag?
questions.note: class=described. Derived from c13439ee0 (C-16/C-17, Port.join). git show c13439ee0: existing class Port (field join + effective_join added), the source counting inside SystemBlueprint.infer_missing_collectors (moved by that commit into the new helper _joining_sources, which is the HEAD site), and _cmd_catalog_plugins (join added to port dicts) changed. Answer includes a class. Caveat: the catalog lines edited are 1020 and 1024, the reference points at the def line.

questions.question: In the filter plugin that emits an event when a detected disc passes a zone on the conveyor, a detection that vanishes inside the zone for a few frames and then reappears next to the same spot produces a second event for the same physical disc. The fix must (a) change the function that makes the 'zone empty -> occupied' trigger decision, and (b) reuse an existing registers field that holds the pixel radius within which a reappearing point counts as the same object. Which function and which registers field?
questions.note: class=described. Derived from 723e17420 (C-42). git show 723e17420: existing _apply_zone_edge rewritten (plus new helper _is_same_object), the registers field max_match_distance gets a new meaning in zone mode. Field in a SchemaBase registers class.

questions.question: The letter-placement plugin can receive its target word from two sources: an operator-writable register and a field of the item arriving on an input port. Today the word coming from the port is latched and shadows later register writes forever. Required: the register becomes the single storage, whichever source wrote last wins, and a change of word is logged with its source. Which method decides the effective word, and which method rebuilds the matcher on word change and writes the log line?
questions.note: class=described. Derived from caf90b220 (C-37). git show caf90b220: existing _resolve_word (latch removed) and _ensure_assembler (source in the log) changed, __init__ too (not scored).

Which handler method parses and validates these arguments, and which method of the helper object that tracks the stopping of child processes must clip the join deadline it passes to the child group?

questions.question: In the robot v2 driver, `RobotState` decides whether a manual connect attempt may start (it returns 'shutdown', 'busy' or 'go'). When the operator presses Disconnect in the middle of a connect, the connect must be refused with a new outcome, checked before the 'busy' case, and the device manager that publishes the connection state after the connect must report 'disconnecting' instead of 'error' for an aborted connect. Which two methods change?
questions.note: class=named. Derived from 4fcf8c9a6 (C-29). git show 4fcf8c9a6: existing RobotState.connect_begin ('cancelled' outcome) and DeviceManager.connect (conn state 'disconnecting') changed.
